rationale: Core slot write with taint API. Frame.write_slot_with_taint at line 229 sets both slot value and taint atomically. Recovery path through vb_runtime/src/recovery.rs:100-105 calls write_slot_with_taint with recovered taint.
Taint enum definition. Taint::Clean, Taint::Secret, Taint::DerivedFromSecret. join_taint used by taint.rs resolved_node_output_taint.
Runtime journal module entry. RuntimeJournalEvent::SlotWritten at chunk_001.rs:106-117 carries taint. RuntimeJournal trait at chunk_001.rs:171-186 defines append interface.
SlotWritten event definition with taint field (line 114). NoopRuntimeJournal and VolatileRuntimeJournal in-memory implementations for tests.

encoded_slot_taint_extra at line 192-194 encodes taint into extra Option<Vec<u8>> via postcard. SlotWrittenEvent mapping at lines 146-159 converts RuntimeJournalEvent::SlotWritten to JournalEvent::SlotWrittenEvent.
Taint resolution for expressions and build operations. resolved_node_output_taint joins contributor taints at lines 64-73. Used by codegen generated code.

Runtime recovery boundary. apply_recovered_slots at lines 100-106 calls frame.write_slot_with_taint with recovered slot entries (value + taint). reject_unsupported_live_frame_state checks seed.unsupported.slot_taint at line 75.
Storage journal event definition. SlotWrittenEvent at lines 97-112: slot, value (postcard-encoded SlotValue), extra (encoded taint via encoded_slot_taint_extra), attempt.

Frame seed building for recovery. record_slot_write at lines 389-411 decodes value and extracts taint via recovered_slot_taint. FrameSeedAccumulator stores slot_taint in HashMap<SlotIdx, Taint> at line 288. recovered_slot_taint at lines 428-435 decodes taint from extra or falls back to legacy_slot_taint.
Recovery type definitions. RecoveredSlotEntry has slot, value, taint. RecoveryFrameSeed.slots: Vec<RecoveredSlotEntry>. UnsupportedRecoveryState.slot_taint: bool flag.
Core replay engine. Iterates journal events and accumulates frame seed state. record_slot_write called via FrameSeedAccumulator.
Top-level recovery entry point. Returns RecoveryResult<RecoveryHydration> which can be Summary or FrameSeed.
Generated runtime code. write_slot_with_journal at lines 2472-2475 calls write_slot_with_taint and pushes JournalEvent::SlotWritten. DriveOutput includes taint and journal fields.
Generated test workflow with taint and journal. write_slot_with_journal at line 165. new_with_taints at line 981. SlotWritten event at line 158.
Codec roundtrip test for SlotWrittenEvent with value encoding.

detail: vb_core defines SlotValue, Taint, SlotIdx. vb_storage defines JournalEvent, recovery types. FrameSeedAccumulator in vb_storage uses vb_core types.
vb_runtime/recovery.rs uses vb_core::frame::RunFrame and vb_core types. vb_runtime/journal uses vb_core Taint.
vb_runtime/journal chunk_002 maps RuntimeJournalEvent to JournalEvent. vb_storage/recovery uses vb_storage::JournalEvent.
vb_codegen generates code using vb_core SlotValue, Taint, SlotIdx. GeneratedRunState has slot_taints: [Taint; WORKFLOW_SLOT_COUNT].
JournalEvent::SlotWrittenEvent encodes taint in extra field via postcard. Loss or corruption of extra data causes slot_taint_unsupported recovery state.
recovered_slot_taint falls back to legacy_slot_taint when extra is None. Legacy path infers taint from SlotValue type, which may not preserve intended taint.
write_slot_with_taint allows any Taint value including Taint::Secret. Taint propagation through expressions via resolved_node_output_taint must correctly join contributor taints.
StorageRuntimeJournal and QueuedStorageRuntimeJournal use Mutex for next_seq_by_run. Journal append is serialized per-run.
